shots.caption: Chest Ward bed: 'Admit / transfer here'; the bed shows occupied
Overview (prototype): counts come from recorded bed operations
Manual-format draft · no AI · 'Needs review' until the doctor chooses
Instructions the doctor wrote herself, published as version 1

shots.phone_desc: Real code · simulated delivery (no SMS). Single use, expires in 10 minutes. Her medicines open with Hindi labels.
One tap changes the screen labels to English. Medicine names stay as the doctor typed them.
A chemist can scan the QR to check the hospital's copy. Not for dispensing. Doctor's registration no. is a sample.
She taps 'I have read this version'. This records reading, not consent. This page is in English only.
Where the clip-on unit would connect. No unit exists yet, so a simulator stands in.
Simulated breaths · saved as partial (complete = 10 valid breaths). It coaches practice; it is not a lung test.
Tomorrow, a time, 'Check-up', then Send request. In the app only: no SMS or WhatsApp is sent.

call_subs:
Assistant (scripted): "Namaste, SpiroBuddy's automated care assistant here.
Savitri ji, you missed your exercise {missed} times. Are you okay? Why?"

Savitri (sample answer): "Mild pain near my stitches this morning."
Assistant: "If severe or breathless, get urgent help. Should your nurse call?"

Savitri: "Yes, please call me."
Assistant: "Request sent to your care team. In an emergency, call 112."
demo.nurse_sub: Fixed rules, not AI. "Patient's own words" here = the preset sample answer.
